title: Notice of Intent to Sole Source: Embraer A-29 Super Tucano aircraft On-Call Support
description: 1. DESCRIPTION: The Department of the Air Force, Air Force Test Center (AFTC), Specialized Test Contracting (PZZD) at Edwards Air Force Base, CA, intends to award a sole-source Basic Ordering Agreement (BOA) Firm-Fixed-Price (FFP) contract for Embraer A-29 Super Tucano aircraft On-Call Support. Three (3) fully sealed Embraer A-29 Super Tucano aircraft are currently in storage at Edwards Air Force Base (AFB), California. These aircraft are not expected to return to flight for use by the Air Force. However, on-call maintenance support is required to address limited conditions affecting safe storage, environmental compliance, and ground movement within the installation. The contractor shall furnish all management, labor, supervision, tools, equipment, repair parts, consumables, transportation, and travel required to perform on-call services, except for items expressly identified as Government-furnished. Services under this PWS are limited to non-recurring, as-needed actions associated with, Fuel, hydraulic, and/or oil leak repair or mitigation, Tire repair or replacement, Ground towing and repositioning of aircraft; and Related minor maintenance actions necessary to place the aircraft in a safe storage or towable condition. This effort is intended solely to support stored aircraft in a non-flight status. 2. SOLE SOURCE AUTHORITY: The proposed acquisition will be conducted under the simplified acquisition procedures of Revolutionary FAR Overhaul (RFO) Subpart 13.1, as authorized by RFO 13.106-1(b)(1), Soliciting from a Single Source. The Government intends to award this requirement as a sole-source contract to: Proposed Contractor: Sierra Nevada Company LLC CAGE Code: 6ZVZ8 UEI: G1YKV4VHL8Q5 Socioeconomic Status: Large Business Address: 1150 N Eglin PKWY, Shalimar, Florida 32579-1227 3. TECHNICAL JUSTIFICATION & MARKET RESEARCH FINDINGS: Comprehensive market research conducted under RFO Part 10 has determined that Sierra Nevada Company LLC is the only commercial source capable of satisfying this requirement without the Government incurring unacceptable technical and schedule risks. Unique Technical Expertise: Sierra Nevada Company LLC is a U.S.-based aerospace and defense technology provider delivering mission?ready solutions across multiple domains, with a strong focus on integration, ISR, and multi?domain command and control. The specialize in Aircraft Integration & Modification; Modular, mission?tailored aircraft system design and modification, e.g., M?28 Special Operations Multi?Role Aircraft (SOMA), RAPCON?X� aerial ISR platform. The company's work supports aerospace, national security, and mission?critical integration needs, emphasizing agility, rapid innovation, and interoperability across domains. RFI Results: A Sources Sought FA930427Q5001 was posted to SAM.gov seeking feedback on the draft PWS. Received 0 responses. Interagency Non-Viability: Market research has not found any additional suitable parties, requiring the Air Force to execute a BOA directly to the sole source. 4. THIS IS NOT A REQUEST FOR COMPETITIVE QUOTES: This publication is for informational purposes only and does not constitute a formal Request for Proposal (RFP) or Request for Quote (RFQ). No solicitation package is available. However, in accordance with RFO Part 5, any interested party that believes it possesses the technical capability to meet this requirement may submit a written capability statement. Capability statements must provide clear, documented evidence of the vendor's prior experience with the requirement. All submissions received within five (5) calendar days of the publication of this notice will be evaluated solely for the purpose of determining whether a competitive procurement is in the best interest of the Government. A determination by the Government not to compete this proposed contract based upon responses to this notice is solely within the discretion of the Contracting Officer. Points of Contact Primary Contracting Officer: Thomas J. Shea Email: thomas.shea.3@us.af.mil Alternate Contracting Officer: Marc A. Venzon Email: marc_anthony.venzon@us.af.mil

These areas will involve removal of glue, full spackle, sand and surface preparation to the area, then a final dust wipe down prior to paint. Approximately two (2) metal doors with jambs (both sides) will require painting on this level. Additional door jambs with wood doors will require paint on the jambs only; (iii) Approximately six hundred (600) sq ft of sound barrier wall requires re-habilitation which includes surface preparation, removal / replacement of the top course with new block, and re-painting of both sides of the structure. title: Base and Medical Laundry Services -Qatar and Saudi Arabia
description: Sources Sought Laundry and Dry-Cleaning Services THIS IS A SOURCES SOUGHT ANNOUNCEMENT ONLY. The 379th Contracting Squadron is conducting market research to determine interest and capability of potential sources. This notice does not constitute a commitment by the Government. All information submitted in response to this announcement is voluntary, and the Government will not pay for information requested nor will it compensate any respondent for any cost incurred in developing information provided to the Government. The 379th Contracting Squadron is seeking potential sources for the purchase of Laundry and Dry-Cleaning services in the Qatar and Saudi Arabia regions. Please see Attachments 1, 2 and 3 for complete list of areas to be covered. The recommended North American Industry Classification Systems (NAICS) Code is 812320 - Cleaners, drycleaning and laundry service (except coin-operated) with a size standard of $8M. � If there is a NAICS code that you believe would be more applicable, please provide with your capability statement. Please accompany your capability statement with answers to the following questions: 1. Are you able to provide all the services listed in the requirement? Do you anticipate any challenges? If so, what are they? 2. If it is required to conduct a site visit prior to contract award, approximately how many business days would it take your company to prepare the site for a visit by government representatives? 3. Do you have experience handling and cleaning contaminated medical linen? If so, to whom and for how long? Describe your experience adhering to regulations for handling and cleaning medical linen. 4. Do you have dedicated equipment and processes for handling contaminated medical linen separately from other laundry? Describe the segregation process. 5. Describe your quality control procedures to ensure that linen is thoroughly cleaned, disinfected, and free of damage. 6. Describe your transportation methods for both soiled and clean linen and how often do you sanitize your transport vehicles? 7. Are you able to handle specialized cleaning needs, such as stain removal or repairs? 8. Do you have a system for monitoring and controlling water temperature and chemical concentrations during the washing process? 9. Do you intend to provide a quote for this requirement? How many days would you need to draft a quote? Provide any additional questions or comments related to the requirement. All responses will be posted. This Sources Sought Announcement is solely for informational and planning purposes only and is not a solicitation or Request for Quote. Please send responses to: SrA Dominique Henry, Contracting Officer, Dominique.henry.1@us.af.mil no later than 12:00PM Arabian Standard Time on 14 November, 2025.

description: In der Baumaßnahme werden im Gewerk Elektrische Anlagen folgende Hauptkomponenten und Leistungsumfänge ausgeführt: 1 Stück Zentralbatteriesystem (11 kW, 1-phasig) zur Versorgung von ca. 360 Sicherheits- und Rettungszeichenleuchten unterschiedlicher Bauart, 1 Stück Photovoltaikanlage mit 125 Modulen (je mind. 430 Wp) und 4 Wechselrichtern (2 x 25 kW / 2 x 20 kW), 1 Stück Gebäudehauptverteilung sowie 1 Stück Hauptverteilung RLT als Standverteiler, 11 Stück Unterverteilungen als Stand- bzw. Wandverteiler, ca. 630 m Kabelrinnen unterschiedlicher Breiten mit zugehörigen Auslegern, Steigleitern und Elektroinstallationsrohren, ca. 82,5 km Installationsleitungen (NYM-J) sowie ca. 1,3 km Starkstromkabel (NYY-J/NYCWY), über 500 Schutzkontaktsteckdosen und Schalter sowie ca.70 Präsenzmelder für die KNX-gesteuerte Raumautomation, 1 Stück KNX-Gebäudevisualisierung mit Programmierung von 200 Lichtszenen, ca. 570 LED-Leuchten für die Allgemeinbeleuchtung sowie über 500 Strahler und Sonderleuchten (NV- und Hochvolt-Stromschienensysteme) für die Ausstellungsbeleuchtung, diverse Erdungs- und Potentialausgleichskomponenten sowie ca. 330 Brand-, Kombi- und Weichschotts.

title: QED Preventative and Remedial Maintenance Service
description: THIS IS NOT A REQUEST FOR COMPETITIVE PROPOSALS. In accordance with FAR subpart 13.5 and 41 U.S.C. 1901, the Bureau of Engraving and Printing (BEP) Office of the Treasury Common Services Center (TCSC) on behalf of its Office of Quality Operations intends to award a sole source contract to Authentix, Inc. for Quality Evaluation Detectors (QED) Preventative and Remedial Maintenance Service. Authentix Inc. is the sole-source provider of all services related to the Quality Evaluation Detector (QED). Because the systems are proprietary and require access to classified information for proper servicing, Authentix does not engage third-party vendors to perform system-level services. The anticipated Period of Performance is for one (1) twelve-month base period and four (4) twelve-month option periods. The places of performance will be performed at the contractor's repair depot location. This notice of intent is not a request for competitive offers/quotes/proposals. A determination not to compete this requirement is solely within the discretion of the government. Information received will be considered solely for the purpose of determining whether to conduct a competitive procurement. The solicitation will not be posted. To be considered, responses must be received NO LATER THAN 4:00PM EST, November 14, 2026. Additionally, interested sources must be registered and currently active in the System for Award Management (SAM), found at https://www.sam.gov. Responses MUST be submitted within the closing date/time of publication of this notice. Point of Contact regarding this notice is Contracting Officer Laqulla Williams, at Laqulla.Williams@bep.gov.
